ca8f7c667997eb.s: The 16th BRICS Trade Ministers' Meeting, which concluded on 7 August 2026, was held in:
ca8f7c667997eb.x: It was held at Sawai Man Mahal, Jaipur. Bhopal hosted the BRICS Culture Ministers' Meeting and Goa the Ocean and Polar S&T Working Group meeting.

ca8cbaeaa5722a.s: Which of the following pairs of BRICS meetings (2026) and venues is correctly matched?
o: 8th BRICS Heads of Prosecution Services – Kochi
Heads of BRICS Anti-Drug Agencies – Guwahati
ca8cbaeaa5722a.x: The Anti-Drug Agencies meeting was held in Guwahati. The Women Ministers met in Kochi, the Science Academies Forum was at IIT Hyderabad and the Prosecution Services meeting was virtual.

caef885cbb8ef1.s: The BRICS Disaster Risk Reduction Ministers' meeting of July 2026 was held in:
caef885cbb8ef1.x: It was held in New Delhi, led by the NDMA and MHA. Chandigarh, Nagpur and Hyderabad were linked with other BRICS ministerial meetings.

cae680253d4099.s: What is the theme of the 18th BRICS Summit hosted by India in 2026?
o: AI for Sustainable Development and Global South cooperation
Building for Resilience, Inclusion, Cooperation and Security
Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability
Bridging Regions for Inclusive Cooperation and Sustainability
cae680253d4099.x: The theme spells out BRICS as 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'. 'AI for Sustainable Development and Global South cooperation' was linked with the Science Academies Forum.

ca932845bbf399.s:
Consider the following statements about the G7:
1. It is a treaty-based organisation with a permanent secretariat.
2. The European Union participates in it as an enumerated member.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca932845bbf399.x: Both are wrong: the G7 is informal, with no treaty and no permanent secretariat, and the EU participates as a non-enumerated member.

ca4982384ef364.s:
With reference to India's proposals at the 52nd G7 Summit Outreach Session, consider:
1. IMPACT stands for International Mobilisation Partnership for Accelerating Connectivity and Trade.
2. IMPACT envisages G7 capital, India's talent and Global South ownership.
3. India proposed a Global Skills Partnership.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca4982384ef364.x: All three are correct: India proposed IMPACT with this partnership model, along with a Global Skills Partnership.

caa666ff1313d2.s:
With reference to President Droupadi Murmu's visit to Romania (23 July 2026), consider:
1. Three agreements were signed in Science and Technology, Sports, and Indian Studies.
2. An Indian Studies Chair was set up at the University of Bucharest through the ICCR.
3. 2028 was designated the 'India–Romania Year of Innovation'.
Which of the above statements are correct?
caa666ff1313d2.x: All three are correct: three agreements were signed, an ICCR Indian Studies Chair was set up at the University of Bucharest, and 2028 was named the India–Romania Year of Innovation.

ca0664b019414e.s: During President Murmu's Moldova visit (July 2026), the bilateral '3Ts' focus stood for:
ca0664b019414e.x: The visit focused on the 3Ts – Trade, Technology and Talent – and ITEC slots for Moldova were doubled.

ca824a4bf32e99.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The ITEC programme was started in 1964 and is managed by the Ministry of External Affairs.
2. The Indian Council for Cultural Relations was established in 1964.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca824a4bf32e99.x: ITEC began in 1964 under the MEA, but the ICCR was established in 1950, not 1964.

ca02bbb0aef0aa.s: The India–France Innovation Roadmap 2030 builds on which combination?
o: India–France Declaration on AI 2025 and AI Impact Summit 2026
Horizon 2047 roadmap and India–France Year of Innovation 2026
Horizon 2047 roadmap and AI Action Summit 2025
India–France Year of Innovation 2026 and AI Impact Summit 2026
ca02bbb0aef0aa.x: The Roadmap builds on the Horizon 2047 roadmap and the India–France Year of Innovation 2026.

ca8174393fc6a7.s: On which date were India–France ties elevated to a Special Global Strategic Partnership?
ca8174393fc6a7.x: India–France ties were elevated to a Special Global Strategic Partnership on 17 February 2026.

ca7b386dcb5005.s: The India–France Innovation Roadmap 2030 is based on which combination?
ca7b386dcb5005.x: Its stated basis is Viksit Bharat 2047 together with France 2030; Horizon 2047 is part of its wider background.

caf6e0bb2665e1.s: The India–France ATL Bridge, launched at India Innovates 2026 in Nice, is a collaboration between the Atal Innovation Mission (NITI Aayog) and:
caf6e0bb2665e1.x: The ATL Bridge was launched by the Atal Innovation Mission of NITI Aayog and the Dassault Systèmes Foundation.

cac0610d7a88ca.s: The 25th India–China Special Representatives talks, held in Beijing on 25 August 2026, were between Ajit Doval and:
cac0610d7a88ca.x: The Special Representatives talks were between Ajit Doval and Wang Yi; Doval met Vice President Han Zheng separately.

cadda0921ff87d.s: Which programme did Nauru launch as a non-debt climate-finance mechanism?
o: Nauru Economic and Climate Resilience Citizenship Program
cadda0921ff87d.x: Nauru launched the Nauru Economic and Climate Resilience Citizenship Program as a non-debt climate-finance mechanism.

ca09d9c743043b.s: The Critical Minerals Global Supply Chain Observatory, launched in New Delhi on 5 June 2026, is an initiative of:
o: TEXMiN, IIT Kharagpur and University of Oxford
IIT Bombay, NITI Aayog and University of Cambridge
Ministry of Mines, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad and Imperial College London
TEXMiN, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad and University of Cambridge
ca09d9c743043b.x: The Observatory was launched by TEXMiN, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad and the University of Cambridge.

cadc256ad3ae14.s: Which of the following pairs related to India's polar research is correctly matched?
cadc256ad3ae14.x: Maitri was established in 1989. Dakshin Gangotri dates to 1983–84 (later closed), Bharati to 2012, and NCPOR was set up in 1998 at Vasco da Gama, Goa.

ca00d1a26f0b21.s: The 9th India–US Civil Space Joint Working Group meeting (5–6 August 2026) was held in:
ca00d1a26f0b21.x: The 9th India–US Civil Space Joint Working Group met in Bengaluru on 5–6 August 2026.

ca111446409bd1.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India signed the Artemis Accords in 2024 as the 27th country.
2. The Access and Understanding phase of India's Moon Base programme continues till 2029.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca111446409bd1.x: Statement 1 is wrong because India signed the Artemis Accords in 2023 as the 27th country; the Access and Understanding phase does run till 2029.

ca1ec120d06b6e.s: China's first rice crop grown in space, harvested on 5 August 2026, was grown aboard the:
ca1ec120d06b6e.x: The rice was grown and harvested on China's Tiangong space station; Shenzhou-23 was the associated crew spacecraft.

cad273e4050c71.s: Which of the following pairs related to India's space-sector reforms is correctly matched?
o: Opening of the space sector to private players – 2023
Automatic-route FDI for satellite manufacturing and operations – 74%
Automatic-route FDI for launch vehicles and spaceports – 74%
cad273e4050c71.x: Automatic FDI up to 74% is allowed for satellite manufacturing and operations (49% for launch vehicles and spaceports); the sector opened in 2020 and the Space Policy came in 2023.

ca653da59bf6d2.s: Astrobase Space Technologies' 'Everest' engine, unveiled in Bengaluru in August 2026, uses which propellants?
ca653da59bf6d2.x: Everest is a methalox engine (liquid oxygen and liquid methane) meant for reusable medium-to-heavy launchers.

cab87eade0be7c.s: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, launched on 30 August 2026, is a mission of:
cab87eade0be7c.x: Roman is a NASA mission; SpaceX's Falcon Heavy only launched it from Kennedy Space Center towards Sun–Earth L2.

ca17f1e190b8fe.s: Lohia Aerospace Systems collaborated with which Israeli firm on a large-format 3D-printing initiative (August 2026)?
ca17f1e190b8fe.x: Lohia Aerospace Systems partnered with Massivit of Israel for large-format 3D printing.

ca466b8dd25a37.s:
Consider the following statements about Vikram-I:
1. It was launched on 18 July 2026 from SDSC Sriharikota.
2. It was India's first private orbital rocket launch from Indian soil.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca466b8dd25a37.x: Both are correct: Vikram-I lifted off from SDSC Sriharikota on 18 July 2026, India's first private orbital launch from Indian soil.

caaad878642c57.s: Besides computing, India's National Quantum Mission covers:
caaad878642c57.x: The National Quantum Mission covers communication, sensing and materials in addition to computing.

cae03f2510e708.s: At the 56th International Physics Olympiad 2026 in Bucaramanga, Colombia, India won:
o: Four gold and one silver medal
Three gold and two silver medals
cae03f2510e708.x: India won five gold medals at the 56th IPhO in Bucaramanga, Colombia.

ca1434af146eeb.s: Which of the following pairs of Vikram-I payloads and their purposes is correctly matched?
o: SCOPE – Robotic arm for debris capture
Grahaa / SOLARAS S3 – Skyroot's own satellite for flight data
ca1434af146eeb.x: DCUBED was the German technology demonstration. SCOPE was Skyroot's own flight-data satellite, Grahaa / SOLARAS S3 was for Earth observation/technology and Cosmoserve Embrace was the debris-capture robotic arm.

ca716bdec21088.s: Which Indian-origin NASA astronaut reached the International Space Station aboard Soyuz MS-29?
ca716bdec21088.x: Anil Menon, an Indian-origin NASA astronaut, reached the ISS aboard Soyuz MS-29.

caa2b8b24a8c67.s: Aruna Asaf Ali, after whom the decommissioned ICGS Aruna Asaf Ali was named and who hoisted the flag in the 1942 Quit India movement, is popularly known as the:
caa2b8b24a8c67.x: Aruna Asaf Ali, who hoisted the flag during the 1942 Quit India movement, is known as the 'Grand Old Lady'.

ca1870fa0d79b2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's indigenous process for HFO-1234yf?
o: It is India's first indigenous process for HFO-1234yf.
It was developed by CSIR-IICT Bengaluru.
The process supports the Kigali Amendment.
ca1870fa0d79b2.x: The process was developed by CSIR-IICT Hyderabad, not Bengaluru; the other statements are correct.

ca6b8c0de2a45a.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India's digital public infrastructure includes UPI, RuPay, Aadhaar, DigiLocker and ONDC.
2. The Digital Rupee is a liability of the RBI, whereas UPI money is a bank's deposit liability.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca6b8c0de2a45a.x: Both are correct: these platforms form India's DPI, and the Digital Rupee is an RBI liability while UPI money is a bank deposit liability.

ca662d5c8a03d9.s: Digital India, which marked its anniversary on 1 July 2026, was launched in:
ca662d5c8a03d9.x: Digital India was launched in 2015 and completed 11 years on 1 July 2026.

ca0dd8ebfc200e.s: India's first Centre of Excellence for plant cell fermentation was set up at IIT Madras, Chennai, in collaboration with:
ca0dd8ebfc200e.x: Herbalife and IIT Madras set up the centre, which grows plant cells in bioreactors for phytochemicals.

cafdc05002e954.s: PSLV technology is being transferred to eligible private Indian firms through:
cafdc05002e954.x: The transfer of PSLV technology to eligible Indian-owned private firms is being done through IN-SPACe.

caf8de48f36196.s: Which exoplanet did the James Webb Space Telescope study for rocky mineral clouds that form in the morning and vanish by evening?
caf8de48f36196.x: JWST studied WASP-94A b, about 700 light-years away, where rocky mineral clouds form in the morning and vanish by evening.

ca2d3eb0be8825.s: Which institution developed India's first technology for Blue Swimmer Crab farming using hatchery seed and pellet feed?
ca2d3eb0be8825.x: ICAR-CIBA, Chennai developed the technology for the Blue Swimmer Crab (Portunus reticulatus).

cacff7f49eb599.s: Which of the following countries was a partner of the South Asia Satellite (GSAT-9), launched on 5 May 2017?
cacff7f49eb599.x: The South Asia Satellite served Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Bhutan and Maldives.

ca848559f6eb74.shape: one-liner (restyle: the NOT set rested on a single fact, so it is asked directly)
ca848559f6eb74.s: In April 2026, Indian CCTV networks were compromised via EseeCloud, a platform from which country?
ca848559f6eb74.x: EseeCloud is a Chinese platform, used in the April 2026 compromise of Indian CCTV networks.

ca1f480b84d44c.s: Which facility, linked with commercial production, was cited as a step towards India's digital sovereignty?
ca1f480b84d44c.x: The Micron ATMP facility in Gujarat was associated with commercial production as a step towards digital sovereignty.

cad705897ab9b0.s:
Consider the following statements about ICGS Akshay:
1. It is an Air Cushion Vehicle.
2. It was commissioned at Kolkata.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cad705897ab9b0.x: Neither: ICGS Akshay is a Fast Patrol Vessel commissioned at Goa Shipyard on 27 June 2026.

cab29512909409.s: SOLAR-1, described as the USA's first dedicated space-weather satellite, is associated with:
cab29512909409.x: SOLAR-1 is NOAA's first dedicated space-weather satellite.

ca9f4431cef50f.s: Which of the following pairs of ISRO missions and details is correctly matched?
o: Bharatiya Antariksh Station – Sample return in 2027
ca9f4431cef50f.x: Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX is with JAXA. Chandrayaan-4 is the 2027 sample-return mission, the Venus Orbiter is due in March 2028 and the BAS has five modules.

ca97f6aa0a5d29.s:
Consider the following statements about IMAT-05:
1. It is an Integrated Main Parachute Airdrop Test for Gaganyaan, conducted at the ADRDE drop zone in Sheopur, Madhya Pradesh.
2. The parachute tested is meant for G1, the first uncrewed Gaganyaan mission.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca97f6aa0a5d29.x: Both are correct: IMAT-05 tested Gaganyaan's main parachute at Sheopur, for the uncrewed G1 mission.

cafda4f245c608.s: ArsenSafe, the portable arsenic detector of IIT Bhubaneswar and Nano Semic, gives a result in about ____ without a laboratory.
cafda4f245c608.x: ArsenSafe gives a result in 17.4 seconds without a laboratory, using reduced graphene oxide FET sensors and machine learning.

ca6ded9586032d.s:
Consider the following statements about TRISHNA:
1. It is scheduled for launch in 2028.
2. Its thermal infrared instrument is provided by ISRO.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca6ded9586032d.x: Neither: TRISHNA is due in 2027, and its thermal infrared instrument comes from CNES (ISRO provides the VNIR-SWIR instrument).

cae388696f6561.s: Which of the following pairs of ISRO missions and descriptions is correctly matched?
o: Mangalyaan – Reached Mars orbit in its maiden attempt
cae388696f6561.x: Mangalyaan reached Mars orbit in its maiden attempt. AstroSat is the first multi-wavelength observatory, XPoSat is for X-ray astronomy and Chandrayaan-2 has the 30 cm resolution orbiter.

ca12e0b484d41b.s: The Agni-IV missile test from the Integrated Test Range, Chandipur, was conducted by:
ca12e0b484d41b.x: The test was conducted by the Strategic Forces Command; DRDO developed the missile.

cac732d7f92dbe.s: DRDO's ADRDE tested the Military Combat Parachute System at which site in Ladakh?
cac732d7f92dbe.x: The Military Combat Parachute System was tested at the Nyoma–Mudh Drop Zone in Ladakh.

ca5a6eee40656d.s: The indigenous shore-based Launch and Recovery System Test Plinth at Visakhapatnam is used to launch and recover the:
ca5a6eee40656d.x: The LARS Test Plinth launches and recovers the Deep Submergence Rescue Vehicle.

cabaeda2b35cf4.s: Telangana's first next-generation AI-enabled integrated Dial 112 system in Hyderabad was inaugurated by:
o: Union Minister of State for Home Affairs
cabaeda2b35cf4.x: DGP C.V. Anand inaugurated the system; the MHA is linked with the National Emergency Response Support System behind 112.

cad723639a1fc5.s: India's first Required Navigation Performance–Category H (RNP-H) helicopter approach was implemented on 7 August 2026 at:
cad723639a1fc5.x: HAL Airport, Bengaluru was the first to implement RNP-H; AAI designed it, HAL test pilots validated it and DGCA approved it.

caaa23f215901b.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Defence Testing Portal provides access to facilities of 24 DRDO laboratories.
2. The Defence Acquisition Council is chaired by the Prime Minister.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caaa23f215901b.x: Statement 1 is correct; the DAC is chaired by the Defence Minister, not the Prime Minister.

cab565302708da.s: India's first permanent shore-based Launch and Recovery System (LARS) Test Plinth was established at:
cab565302708da.x: The fully indigenous LARS Test Plinth was set up at the Submarine Rescue Unit (East), Visakhapatnam.

ca769035850691.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. NIDAR 2.0 was launched by MeitY with IIT Madras.
2. VEGA is an indigenous RISC-V processor developed under DIR-V.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca769035850691.x: NIDAR 2.0 was launched by MeitY with the Drone Federation of India, so 1 is wrong; VEGA is an indigenous RISC-V processor under Digital India RISC-V (DIR-V).

ca74ff8a68323e.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: IAU – Established in 1958 at Washington D.C.
JWST – Joint mission of NASA, ESA and CSA
ca74ff8a68323e.x: JWST is a NASA–ESA–CSA mission. The IAU was founded in 1919 at Paris, NASA in 1958 at Washington D.C., and LEO spans 160–2,000 km.

ca95a577bcd21c.s: Which of the following pairs related to Semicon 2.0 is correctly matched?
o: ATMP – Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test
OSAT – Assembly, Testing, Marking and Packaging
ca95a577bcd21c.x: Semicon 2.0 has an outlay of ₹1,27,500 crore and six pillars; ATMP is Assembly, Testing, Marking and Packaging, and OSAT is Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test.

ca53c7db468cd9.s:
Consider the following statements about Aadhaar-linked platforms:
1. Aadhaar coverage exceeded 144 crore.
2. Direct Benefit Transfer exceeded ₹51 lakh crore.
3. Aadhaar authenticated 100% of the Public Distribution System.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca53c7db468cd9.x: 1 and 2 are correct; statement 3 is wrong because the figure for PDS authentication was more than 98%, not 100%.

cab8c76c0c5991.s: The Advanced Weapon Systems Complex at Hyderabad was developed by:
o: DRDO's Missile Systems and Strategic Systems Cluster
cab8c76c0c5991.x: The Advanced Weapon Systems Complex was developed by DRDO's Missile Systems and Strategic Systems Cluster.

caae81956a0401.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's defence procurement and industrial policy?
o: The DPM 2025 relates to capital procurement of about ₹1 lakh crore.
The procurement of 156 LCH Prachand helicopters was valued at about ₹62,700 crore.
The procurement of 97 Tejas Mk-1A aircraft was valued at about ₹62,000 crore.
An industrial licence is valid for 15 years, extendable by 3 years to a maximum of 18 years.
caae81956a0401.x: DPM 2025 relates to revenue procurement of about ₹1 lakh crore, not capital procurement; the other statements are correct.

ca4ec8a6682b41.s: According to PIB data, India's electric-vehicle sales in 2025 were about:
ca4ec8a6682b41.x: EV sales rose to about 23 lakh in 2025 from about 50,000 in 2016, nearly 46 times growth.

ca36786ef7e79d.s:
Consider the following statements about the Gnani Artha sovereign AI stack:
1. It was launched by Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan in New Delhi on 28 August 2026.
2. It aims to develop an indigenous sovereign AI stack and large language models while ensuring data sovereignty.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca36786ef7e79d.x: Both are correct: the Gnani AI stack was launched by the Vice-President on 28 August 2026 to build sovereign AI with data sovereignty.

cacf4bb42e3244.s: In 2025–26, the Indian Army's ammunition self-sufficiency, covering 159 of 175 variants, was about:
cacf4bb42e3244.x: The Army achieved about 91% self-sufficiency in ammunition, covering 159 of 175 variants.

ca72d20b364d71.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The India Electric Mobility Index was released by the Ministry of Heavy Industries in August 2025.
2. India targets 30% EV penetration by 2030, and transport contributes about 9% of emissions.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca72d20b364d71.x: The India Electric Mobility Index (August 2025) was from NITI Aayog, so 1 is wrong; statement 2 is correct.

ca6ac42cfdd821.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The 7th ICG–Vietnam Coast Guard High-Level Meeting was held at Kochi on 25 August 2026.
2. The Indian Coast Guard was established on 1 February 1978.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca6ac42cfdd821.x: Neither: the meeting was held at Chennai, and the Coast Guard was established on 1 February 1977 (1978 is the year of the Coast Guard Act).

caf000b333833c.s: Which ship, the sixth stealth frigate of Project 17A, was introduced at Visakhapatnam on 11 July 2026?
caf000b333833c.x: Mahendragiri was introduced at Visakhapatnam on 11 July 2026 as the sixth Project 17A stealth frigate.

cadac0cbe5d9cc.s: Who inaugurated the Advanced Weapon Systems Complex in Hyderabad on 12 June 2026?
cadac0cbe5d9cc.x: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh inaugurated the complex at the Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Missile Complex, Hyderabad.

ca95398af10839.s: The first India-made C295 aircraft, produced by TASL and Airbus, made its first flight from:
ca95398af10839.x: The first India-made C295 flew from Vadodara; 16 aircraft come from Spain and 40 are being made in India.

ca7079dd968a17.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Jan Dhan accounts rose from 14.72 crore to 57.78 crore by February 2026, with deposits of ₹2.49 lakh crore.
2. India Stack Global and the Global DPI Repository were launched in February 2026.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca7079dd968a17.x: Neither: Jan Dhan deposits were ₹2.94 lakh crore, and India Stack Global and the Global DPI Repository were launched during India's G20 Presidency.

caa229483d2f32.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Russia offered the Su-57 with joint production and full technology transfer at SPIEF 2021.
2. India left the FGFA programme in 2026.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caa229483d2f32.x: Neither: the Su-57 offer was made at SPIEF 2026, and India left the FGFA programme in 2021.

ca6770699200d6.s: Which of the following pairs of platforms inducted in June 2026 is correctly matched?
o: Agray – ICG's first indigenous Air Cushion Vehicle
ca6770699200d6.x: Sanshodhak is the 4th large survey vessel. Dunagiri is the 5th Project 17A frigate, Agray the 4th Arnala-class ASW-SWC and H-561 the ICG's first indigenous Air Cushion Vehicle.

caf443007055fb.s: Qdenga, approved by the DCGI in July 2026 as India's first dengue vaccine covering all four serotypes, is approved for which age group?
caf443007055fb.x: Qdenga is approved for people aged 4–60 and covers all four dengue serotypes.

cad36a36491a74.s:
Consider the following statements about Vepdegestrant:
1. It is the world's first PROTAC drug for advanced breast cancer.
2. It was approved by the DCGI.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cad36a36491a74.x: Vepdegestrant is the first PROTAC drug for advanced breast cancer, but it was approved by the US FDA, not the DCGI.

caff154c3b43f3.s: Which ICRISAT groundnut variety was identified as India's first high-oleic variety, with 7–12% higher yield?
caff154c3b43f3.x: ICGV 181030 is India's first high-oleic groundnut variety; ICGV 201214 is another ICRISAT variety in the same development.

ca24d0fb334f1d.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The One Health Centre for Nipah Research and Resilience was set up at Kozhikode in 2023 and has more than 2.5 lakh surveillance volunteers.
2. Nipah is a WHO priority pathogen, and Kerala's watch-list includes Nipah, H5N1 and Kyasanur Forest Disease.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca24d0fb334f1d.x: Both are correct: the Kozhikode One Health Centre dates from 2023 with over 2.5 lakh volunteers, and Nipah is a WHO priority pathogen on Kerala's watch-list.

cad44bef581a62.s: Which of the following pairs of electric-vehicle types is correctly matched?
cad44bef581a62.x: A PHEV is a hybrid with a plug-in battery. A BEV runs on battery only, an HEV has engine + motor, and an FCEV uses a fuel cell, usually hydrogen.

ca1f6e135b8365.s: India's first hydrogen train was flagged off on 17 July 2026 from:
ca1f6e135b8365.x: PM Modi flagged off the hydrogen train at Jind, Haryana; Sonipat is on its route.

ca650a023ba2d5.s:
Consider the following statements about the Puga Valley geothermal project:
1. It is a 1 MW demonstration-scale geothermal power project.
2. It was executed by the ONGC Energy Centre and is linked to Carbon-Neutral Ladakh.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca650a023ba2d5.x: Both are correct: it is India's first 1 MW demonstration geothermal project, executed by the ONGC Energy Centre for Carbon-Neutral Ladakh.

cac8b974774a2d.s: The Google-linked 1 GW AI data-centre hub in Andhra Pradesh, which drew protests, is in which area?
cac8b974774a2d.x: The hub is in the Visakhapatnam–Anakapalli area, with land at Adavivaram-Mudasarlova, Tarluvada and Rambilli.

ca3b6004d1c776.s:
Consider the following statements about India's first hydrogen train:
1. It needs no overhead wires and gives out water vapour as a by-product.
2. It uses Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell technology.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca3b6004d1c776.x: Both are correct: the train runs without overhead wires, emits only water vapour and uses PEM fuel-cell technology.

ca3140c3ae1119.s: India's first hydrogen train (17 July 2026) was developed under which Indian Railways initiative?
ca3140c3ae1119.x: The train was built under Indian Railways' 'Hydrogen for Heritage' initiative; the National Green Hydrogen Mission is a separate MNRE mission.

ca546f93f2b89b.s: The National Policy on Geothermal Energy, 2025 supports India's target of Net Zero by:
ca546f93f2b89b.x: The geothermal policy supports India's Net Zero 2070 objective.

cada149bf043cd.s: Which of the following pairs of regions and geothermal sites is correctly matched?
cada149bf043cd.x: Yumesamdong is in Sikkim. Puga is in Ladakh, Manikaran in Himachal Pradesh and Tapoban in Uttarakhand.

ca9cb60b2776ce.s:
Consider the following statements about CODENE, India's first Centre of Design Engineering for Nuclear Energy:
1. It is located at IIT Madras.
2. It is being set up at IIT Hyderabad with CEEPL and Dassault Systèmes.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca9cb60b2776ce.x: CODENE is at IIT Hyderabad, set up under a tripartite arrangement with CEEPL and Dassault Systèmes, not at IIT Madras.

caafff42c41c26.s: The world's most detailed 3D atlas of the human brainstem was developed by:
o: Sudha Gopalakrishnan Brain Centre, IIT Madras
caafff42c41c26.x: The 3D brainstem atlas was developed by the Sudha Gopalakrishnan Brain Centre at IIT Madras.

caf64b4d7e4e7d.s: India's second launch site at Kulasekarapattinam, Tamil Nadu, is meant mainly for:
caf64b4d7e4e7d.x: Kulasekarapattinam is the second launch site, intended for SSLV and private use; Sriharikota has two pads with a third coming.

ca6640f3b05152.s: Which cooling technology did IIT Madras develop using an 'Anti-Parallel Arrangement' for electronics and electric vehicles?
ca6640f3b05152.x: IIT Madras developed the Flat Plate Pulsating Heat Pipe with an 'Anti-Parallel Arrangement' for cooling electronics and EVs.

caf567b797f72b.s: Which of the following pairs related to ISRO's international cooperation is correctly matched?
caf567b797f72b.x: TRISHNA is with France. NISAR is with NASA, LUPEX with Japan, and India launched 399 foreign satellites during 2014–March 2026.

ca9bf7ab79e082.s:
Consider the following statements about the AK-203 prototype 'Sher':
1. It uses a 5.56×45 mm calibre.
2. It was tested by a Russian company at the Korwa Ordnance facility in Amethi.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca9bf7ab79e082.x: Neither: Sher uses the 7.62×39 mm calibre, and it was tested by Indo-Russian Rifles Pvt Ltd, an India–Russia joint venture.

ca7e2d210542de.s: Which of the following was identified as a potential use of AI-assisted generative biology in the bacteriophage research?
ca7e2d210542de.x: The stated uses were phage therapy against antimicrobial resistance, AAV gene-delivery vectors and oncolytic viruses.

ca6443278f509f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Central Industrial Security Force (CISF)?
o: It was set up under the CISF Act, 1968.
It functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
It is a Central Armed Police Force.
ca6443278f509f.x: The CISF was established on 10 March 1969; only the CISF Act dates to 1968.

cae11ae4f536a1.s: Who unveiled the NIKA2 Kisan Medium Drone?
cae11ae4f536a1.x: Shivraj Singh Chouhan unveiled the drone, built by Janaki Pulaparthi, founder of Akin Analytics.

cabaaf3e7ed6b7.s: Which of the following pairs of qubit types and features is correctly matched?
o: Trapped-ion qubit – Charged atoms in electromagnetic fields
Photonic qubit – Semiconductor materials such as silicon
cabaaf3e7ed6b7.x: Trapped-ion qubits use charged atoms held in electromagnetic fields. Superconducting qubits use Josephson junctions, quantum-dot qubits use semiconductors and photonic qubits use photons.

ca606dcace18f2.s: Which of the following pairs related to India's maritime organisations is correctly matched?
o: Director General, Indian Coast Guard – Krishna Swaminathan
ca606dcace18f2.x: Mazagon Dock dates to 1934 and Cochin Shipyard to 1972; Krishna Swaminathan is the Navy Chief and Paramesh Sivamani the Coast Guard DG.

ca2afb1017dc48.s: Who was the lone Indian among the 40 members of the UN's Independent International Scientific Panel on AI?
ca2afb1017dc48.x: Prof. B. Ravindran, head of the Centre for Responsible AI at IIT Madras, was the only Indian on the 40-member panel.

caed72e5a87d4f.s: What is the significance of the Independent International Scientific Panel on AI in the UN-backed AI governance process?
o: It is the institutional mechanism for the IndiaAI Mission
It is an open repository of AI safety-testing tools and datasets
It is the first global scientific body on AI and feeds the Global Dialogue on AI
It is the UN body that adopts binding AI treaties
caed72e5a87d4f.x: The panel is the first global scientific body on AI and feeds the Global Dialogue on AI set up by the UN General Assembly.

ca2c9b0c2727b4.s:
Consider the following statements about the BSNL–IIT Kanpur MoU:
1. It covers Direct-to-Mobile (D2M) broadcasting.
2. It covers indigenous 4G and spectrum research.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca2c9b0c2727b4.x: Both are correct: the MoU covers D2M broadcasting, indigenous 4G and spectrum research.

ca72e89e1fee13.s:
Consider the following statements about the study of glacial lakes in the Mago Chu Basin:
1. The basin is in West Kameng district of Arunachal Pradesh.
2. Three of its five glacial lakes expanded between 2016 and 2026.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca72e89e1fee13.x: Neither: the Mago Chu Basin is in Tawang district, and four of the five glacial lakes expanded between 2016 and 2026.

ca96bdc8c631bd.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The 77th Van Mahotsav was observed from 1 to 7 July 2026; the observance was started in 1950 by K. M. Munshi.
2. The India State of Forest Report is biennial and is brought out by the Forest Survey of India.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca96bdc8c631bd.x: Both are correct: Van Mahotsav was begun by K. M. Munshi in 1950, and the ISFR is a biennial report of the Forest Survey of India.

ca7280563743af.s: India–China border trade through Nathu La is scheduled to resume on:
ca7280563743af.x: Trade through Nathu La is to resume on 1 August 2026; it had been suspended since 2020.

cae88a56699aaf.s: During Delhi's summer pollution episode in May 2026, the CAQM reimposed:
cae88a56699aaf.x: CAQM reimposed GRAP Stage-I in Delhi during the May 2026 episode.

cab138d201e296.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Loo is a hot, long-distance dust wind of North India.
2. Andhi is a hot, long-distance dust wind of North India.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cab138d201e296.x: Loo is a hot long-distance wind, but andhi is a short, local dust storm accompanied by thunderstorms.

ca14248e15fe38.shape: one-liner (restyle: the NOT set hinged on one number, so it is asked directly)
ca14248e15fe38.s: Jai Prakash Narayan Bird Sanctuary (Surha Tal), a bird sanctuary since 1991 and designated a Ramsar site in 2026, is Uttar Pradesh's:
ca14248e15fe38.x: Surha Tal is Uttar Pradesh's 13th Ramsar site.

ca258617b806db.s: Which of the following pairs of wetlands and States is correctly matched?
ca258617b806db.x: Kolleru Lake is Andhra Pradesh's Ramsar site; Chhari-Dhand is in Gujarat and Shekha Jheel in Uttar Pradesh.

ca309726a630cf.s:
Consider the following statements about biochar:
1. Concrete containing 5–8% biochar captures about 115 kg CO2 per cubic metre.
2. The Akola trial used coconut leaf stalk as feedstock in black soil.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca309726a630cf.x: Neither: the stated concrete proportion is 2–5% biochar, and the Akola trial used maize stalk (coconut leaf stalk was used in Kerala).

ca9bc8acbe3e12.s: Who chairs the Supreme Court-appointed expert committee defining the limits of the Aravalli range (report due 31 August 2026)?
ca9bc8acbe3e12.x: The committee is chaired by Kanchan Devi; Guru Shikhar is the Aravallis' highest peak.

ca5372301038c2.s: The Supreme Court's 4 August 2026 order imposing a 10-km mining ban around Wetland Conservation Reserves extended an existing rule for which reserve?
ca5372301038c2.x: The order extended Uttarakhand's rule for the Asan Wetland Conservation Reserve to all Wetland Conservation Reserves.

ca6b0618bf9fed.shape: one-liner (restyle: three of the four NOT options repeated one fact)
ca6b0618bf9fed.s: PM10 refers to particulate matter with a diameter of:
ca6b0618bf9fed.x: PM10 consists of particles 10 micrometres or less in diameter.

ca4a4f0402fcfa.s: Which is the smallest Ramsar site in India?
ca4a4f0402fcfa.x: Vembannur Wetland Complex in Tamil Nadu is now the smallest (Renuka Wetland was earlier); Sundarban Wetland is the largest.

ca8cb9971002f4.s: Which of the following pairs of degraded rivers and cities is correctly matched?
ca8cb9971002f4.x: The Musi flows through Hyderabad; the Sahibi is linked with Delhi, the Mithi with Mumbai and the Cooum with Chennai.

ca15decfa2723b.s: Which of the following pairs of degraded rivers and cities is correctly matched?
ca15decfa2723b.x: Bharalu and Bahini are in Guwahati; Vrishabhavathi is in Bengaluru, Varuna and Assi in Varanasi, and Mula and Mutha in Pune.

ca81dd735d5472.s:
Consider the following statements about the Western Ghats:
1. The expert committee constituted in 2022 on the Eco-Sensitive Area has been extended up to July 2027.
2. The Gadgil Committee (2011) recommended treating the entire Western Ghats as sensitive through ESZ-I, ESZ-II and ESZ-III.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca81dd735d5472.x: Both are correct: the 2022 committee runs till July 2027, and Gadgil (2011) covered the whole Ghats in three sensitivity zones.

ca5869bbe33e31.s: Which of the following pairs related to the Western Ghats is correctly matched?
ca5869bbe33e31.x: Thal Ghat links Mumbai and Nashik. Sahyadri is another name for the Western Ghats, Konkan is the northern coast and Malabar the southern coast.

ca54db74039c73.s: Which of the following pairs of Western Ghats passes and the places they link is correctly matched?
ca54db74039c73.x: The Palghat Gap links Coimbatore and Palakkad. Bhor Ghat links Mumbai–Pune, Amba Ghat Ratnagiri–Kolhapur and Amboli Ghat Sawantwadi–Belgaum.

ca3a8b48cd990b.s: Pulicat Lake is shared by which two States?
ca3a8b48cd990b.x: Pulicat Lake extends across Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.

ca96988c936b39.s: Which of the following pairs related to glacial lake outburst floods (GLOFs) is correctly matched?
ca96988c936b39.x: South Lhonak Lake is in Sikkim. Kedarnath 2013 involved Chorabari lake, the NDMA GLOF Guidelines came in 2020 and the National GLOF Risk Mitigation Project was launched in 2025 in four Himalayan States.

cabbfd7c675533.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Cyttopsis indica – Deep-sea fish from the Bay of Bengal
Syama Prasad Mukherjee – Founder of the Swatantra Party
Cyttopsis indica – New moth species from Karnataka
cabbfd7c675533.x: CMFRI was established in 1947 at Kochi. Cyttopsis indica is a deep-sea fish from the Arabian Sea off Kerala, and Syama Prasad Mukherjee founded the Bharatiya Jana Sangh.

ca42468b4ec0df.s: The proposed Western Ghats Ecologically Sensitive Area notification derives its legal basis from:
ca42468b4ec0df.x: ESAs such as Dahanu, Mahabaleshwar–Panchgani and Doon Valley were notified under the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986, which is also the basis of the Western Ghats ESA.

cafdd6588b3057.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Zoological Survey of India – Established in 1890 at Kolkata
Botanical Survey of India – Established in 1916 at Kolkata
Bryophytes – Seed-bearing plants of the Western Ghats
cafdd6588b3057.x: ATREE was set up in 1996 at Bengaluru. ZSI dates to 1916 and BSI to 1890 (both Kolkata), and bryophytes are called the amphibians of the plant kingdom.

ca84bb2deb43e6.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The GI Act is administered by DPIIT under the Ministry of Commerce.
2. ONDC is administered by the Ministry of Textiles.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca84bb2deb43e6.x: The GI Act is administered by DPIIT; ONDC is associated with DPIIT, not the Ministry of Textiles.

ca8d870536b30f.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The NDMA was set up under the Disaster Management Act, 2005 and is chaired by the Prime Minister.
2. The NDRF functions under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca8d870536b30f.x: Statement 1 is correct; the NDRF functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs.

caa67ac33ea890.s:
Consider the following statements about Kolleru Wildlife Sanctuary:
1. It lies in West Godavari and Krishna districts.
2. It was established in 1999 under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caa67ac33ea890.x: Both are correct: the sanctuary spans West Godavari and Krishna districts and was set up in 1999 under the 1972 Act.

ca6e632f55cf4e.s: Which of the following correctly describes the India Meteorological Department (IMD)?
o: Established 1875; Ministry of Earth Sciences; HQ New Delhi
Established 1875; Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change; HQ New Delhi
Established 1905; Ministry of Earth Sciences; HQ New Delhi
Established 1875; Ministry of Earth Sciences; HQ Mumbai
ca6e632f55cf4e.x: The IMD was set up in 1875, functions under the Ministry of Earth Sciences and is headquartered in New Delhi.

ca419643fdfd58.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. GI registration is valid for 10 years and is renewable every 10 years.
2. The GI Registry is located in Mumbai.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca419643fdfd58.x: GI registration is valid for 10 years and renewable; the GI Registry is in Chennai, not Mumbai.

ca2d4c684567e4.s:
Consider the following statements about ZSI's checklist of butterflies and moths:
1. It is India's first comprehensive checklist of Lepidoptera, covering 13,703 species.
2. It was completed over 10 years and published in 12 volumes.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca2d4c684567e4.x: Statement 1 is correct; the work took 12 years and was published in 22 volumes.

ca765968adba1c.s: Which of the following pairs related to the Zoological Survey of India's Lepidoptera checklist is correctly matched?
ca765968adba1c.x: Geometroidea accounts for 2,205 moth species. ZSI was set up in 1916, is headquartered in Kolkata, and the checklist covers 13,703 species.

ca403633390278.s:
Consider the following statements about the five new Impatiens species reported in 2025:
1. They belong to the family Balsaminaceae.
2. They were reported from Kerala's Eastern Ghats.
3. They were recorded in Idukki and Ernakulam.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca403633390278.x: 1 and 3 are correct; the species were found in Kerala's Western Ghats, not the Eastern Ghats.

cab3cc956bdddf.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Simonia lawbah is a new spider reported from Assam.
2. Hamataliwa papikonda is a new spider reported from Kerala.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cab3cc956bdddf.x: Neither: Simonia lawbah was reported from Meghalaya and Hamataliwa papikonda from Andhra Pradesh.

nd53282beba1.s: The new spiders Hamataliwa papikonda and Simonia lawbah were discovered by:
nd53282beba1.x: Both spiders were discovered by the Zoological Survey of India.

caca43b88d0769.s: The Central Zoo Authority, constituted under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972, was established in:
caca43b88d0769.x: The Central Zoo Authority was established in 1992 under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972.

ca4bcea7edfa5b.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. CA|TS stands for Conservation Assured Tiger Scheme.
2. Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam is the largest Critical Tiger Habitat.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca4bcea7edfa5b.x: CA|TS stands for Conservation Assured Tiger Standards; Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam (Andhra Pradesh and Telangana) is the largest Critical Tiger Habitat.

ca0ba92ad249c5.s:
Consider the following statements about the white-bellied heron:
1. It was first described in 1878 from the Teesta region.
2. Bhutan has no captive-breeding programme for it.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca0ba92ad249c5.x: Statement 1 is correct; Bhutan does have captive breeding, though the bird is no longer found in the Teesta region.

ca05fc3a6c0c3d.s: The resin-rich, inflammable needles of chir pine that feed Himalayan forest fires are locally called:
ca05fc3a6c0c3d.x: Chir pine needles are locally called 'Pirul'; they are resin-rich and highly inflammable.

ca4a45ffda1861.s: Which body directed the Andhra Pradesh government to act against illegal fish ponds in Kolleru Wildlife Sanctuary?
ca4a45ffda1861.x: The Supreme Court-appointed Central Empowered Committee, which assists the Court on forest and wildlife matters, issued the direction.

ca9be983f7f52d.s: Typhoon Bavi prompted rain and flood alerts in which areas before moving across the East China Sea?
ca9be983f7f52d.x: Typhoon Bavi triggered alerts in Japan's Sakishima Islands and Taiwan before crossing the East China Sea.

ca0433a990e171.s: Which organisation recognised Parichha Weir as a World Heritage Irrigation Structure on 13 August 2026?
o: International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage
ca0433a990e171.x: The ICID (est. 1950, HQ New Delhi) recognised Parichha Weir as a World Heritage Irrigation Structure.

cab9616da924df.s:
Consider the following statements about the Sungal Tunnel on the Jammu–Poonch highway:
1. It is 2.79 km long and passes through the Kalidhar Range.
2. It cuts the distance by about 13 km and improves links to Rajouri, Poonch and Nowshera.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cab9616da924df.x: Both are correct: the 2.79 km tunnel through the Kalidhar Range cuts about 13 km of travel.

ca2c8fb6ea5806.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Indira Point, India's southernmost point, was formerly called Pygmalion Point and was renamed in 1985.
2. Ana Sagar Lake was built between 1135 and 1150 AD by Arnoraja Chauhan by damming the Luni River.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca2c8fb6ea5806.x: Both are correct: Indira Point was renamed in 1985, and Arnoraja Chauhan built Ana Sagar between 1135 and 1150 AD.

ca48f6ae4e043b.s:
Consider the following statements about the Great Nicobar Project:
1. The National Green Tribunal cancelled its environmental clearance.
2. The Shompen are classified as a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group.
3. The Giant Leatherback Turtle nests at Galathea Bay.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca48f6ae4e043b.x: 2 and 3 are correct; the NGT refused to interfere with the clearance and demanded strict compliance, so 1 is wrong.

cae33628cee685.s:
Consider the following statements about the Kishau Multipurpose Dam:
1. Five States signed the MoU for the project.
2. The dam is being built on the Sutlej River.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cae33628cee685.x: Neither: six States signed the MoU, and the dam is on the Tons River, the largest tributary of the Yamuna.

ca2ecd339e09b7.s: How does biochar assist vertical farming?
o: It aids nitrogen-fixing microbes and retains water.
It produces syngas and substitutes diesel and kerosene.
It releases nitrogen and improves drainage.
It excludes nitrogen-fixing microbes and reduces water retention.
ca2ecd339e09b7.x: In vertical farming, biochar aids nitrogen-fixing microbes and retains water.

caa918d7e7b08d.s: Fuego volcano, which erupted in southern Guatemala, is a:
caa918d7e7b08d.x: Fuego is a stratovolcano in southern Guatemala.

ca7ad00374badf.s:
Consider the following statements about the Border Roads Organisation:
1. It was established in 1960 and is headquartered in Mumbai.
2. It functions under the Ministry of Defence.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca7ad00374badf.x: The BRO (1960) is headquartered in New Delhi, not Mumbai; it functions under the Ministry of Defence.

ca5854c38ed0f4.s: The giant Pavona clavus coral colony called the 'Potato Patch' was found near which Lakshadweep island?
ca5854c38ed0f4.x: The Potato Patch, about 4,250 sq m and 700–1,800 years old, was found near Kadmat Island.

caf4de8fc1950c.s: Crotalaria phulei, a new flowering plant of the Fabaceae family, is named after:
caf4de8fc1950c.x: Crotalaria phulei is named in honour of Savitribai Phule.

ca0152001120a8.s: With reference to the Environmental Performance Index 2026, which of the following rank–country pairs is correctly matched?
ca0152001120a8.x: The top four were Estonia (1), Luxembourg (2), United Kingdom (3) and Finland (4).

ca4fadd60d401e.s: The 13th edition of the Global Terrorism Index 2026 is published by:
ca4fadd60d401e.x: The Global Terrorism Index is published by the Institute for Economics & Peace (IEP).

ca8cbbcb9b2c73.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Global Passport Index assesses travel freedom, investment opportunities and visa-free access.
2. The Henley Passport Index is published by Global Citizen Solutions.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca8cbbcb9b2c73.x: Neither: the Global Passport Index uses travel freedom, investment opportunities and quality of life, and the Henley Passport Index is by Henley & Partners.

cade0e92320b26.s:
Consider the following statements about the Global Peace Index:
1. It is published by the Institute for Economics and Peace, based in Sydney.
2. It has been published since 2007.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cade0e92320b26.x: Both are correct: the Sydney-based IEP has published the GPI since 2007.

caf91819e62909.s: What was India's rank in the WEF Energy Transition Index 2026?
caf91819e62909.x: India ranked 70th, up 2 places, with a score of 54.9.

ca3e4826817f35.s:
Consider the following statements about India's nuclear doctrine:
1. It was drafted in 2003 and adopted in 1999.
2. It includes a First Use policy and civilian control.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca3e4826817f35.x: Neither: the doctrine was drafted in 1999 and adopted in 2003, and it follows No First Use with civilian control.

ca8a6c257ef561.s: Which of the following country–rank pairs in the Global Peace Index 2026 is correctly matched?
ca8a6c257ef561.x: India ranked 127th; Nepal was 111th, Bangladesh 117th and Pakistan 152nd.

n31929446e7f.s: What was India's rank in the Environmental Performance Index 2026?
n31929446e7f.x: India ranked 176th out of 177 countries, with a score of 22.46.

na69fc64bec4.s: Which country topped the Environmental Performance Index 2026?
na69fc64bec4.x: Estonia topped the EPI 2026 with a score of 74.79, followed by Luxembourg and the United Kingdom.

ca3acde2224366.s: Which State topped NITI Aayog's School Education Quality Index 2026?
ca3acde2224366.x: Punjab ranked first in the 2026 index, up from 27th in 2020.

ca295a042ca401.s: NITI Aayog's report on positioning India as a global manufacturing hub assessed sectors on which criteria?
o: Market potential, competitiveness, infrastructure, technology readiness, exports and FDI inflows
Market potential, competitiveness, infrastructure, technology readiness, jobs and GVC position
Market size, ease of doing business, infrastructure, skills, jobs and GVC position
Competitiveness, infrastructure, R&D spending, jobs, exports and tariff levels
ca295a042ca401.x: The report assessed market potential, competitiveness, infrastructure, technology readiness, jobs and GVC position.

cacee20646bbcb.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The National Education Policy 2020 replaced the National Policy on Education 1986.
2. NEP 2020 introduced a 5+3+3+3 school structure.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cacee20646bbcb.x: NEP 2020 did replace NPE 1986, but its school structure is 5+3+3+4.

cae74872f5c3a0.s: NITI Aayog's School Education Quality Index 2026 assesses which set of parameters?
o: Learning outcomes, access, infrastructure, health, governance and teachers
Learning outcomes, access, infrastructure, equity, governance and nutrition
Learning outcomes, enrolment, infrastructure, equity, finance and teachers
Learning outcomes, access, infrastructure, equity, governance and teachers
cae74872f5c3a0.x: The index assesses learning outcomes, access, infrastructure, equity, governance and teachers.

ca7ebb9ff6a0c9.s: Which four sectors were identified in NITI Aayog's report 'Key Sectors to Position India as a Global Manufacturing Hub'?
o: Chemicals; Textiles; Telecom and Networking Equipment; Solar PV Manufacturing
Chemicals; Textiles; Electronics; Solar PV Manufacturing
Chemicals; Leather; Telecom and Networking Equipment; Solar PV Manufacturing
Pharmaceuticals; Textiles; Telecom and Networking Equipment; Battery Storage
ca7ebb9ff6a0c9.x: The report identified Chemicals, Textiles, Telecom and Networking Equipment, and Solar Photovoltaic Manufacturing.

ca785f7c92799a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the categories of the Investment Friendliness Index 2026?
o: Top Performers have a score above 50.
Frontrunners score between 45 and 50 and include 15 States.
Aspiring States score below 45 and include 8 States.
ca785f7c92799a.x: Aspiring States score below 40, not below 45; the 40–45 band belongs to Emerging Performers.

ca35245a25bc0c.s:
Consider the following statements about the PLI-Auto scheme:
1. Tamil Nadu ranked first in its implementation with 66 units.
2. It has an outlay of ₹25,398 crore.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca35245a25bc0c.x: Neither: Maharashtra ranked first with 66 units, and the outlay is ₹25,938 crore.

cae84702c06068.s: Which of the following State–rank pairs in the Investment Friendliness Index 2026 is correctly matched?
cae84702c06068.x: Gujarat ranked 1st with 56.6; Maharashtra was 2nd (53.7), Goa 4th (53.1) and Odisha 5th (52.4).

ca6b55ba25fbba.s:
Consider the following statements about the Investment Friendliness Index 2026:
1. Andhra Pradesh and Telangana were flagged for slow incentive disbursement.
2. The North-Eastern region accounted for 85% of FDI.
3. Maharashtra, Karnataka, Gujarat, Delhi and Tamil Nadu together accounted for 85% of FDI.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca6b55ba25fbba.x: 1 and 3 are correct; the North-Eastern region received less than 1% of FDI.

ca9da50e859184.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
ca9da50e859184.x: The proposed Bioeconomy Fund is ₹50,000 crore. The bioeconomy is projected at USD 691 billion by 2035 and USD 2.6 trillion by 2047, and the Green Hydrogen Mission dates to 2023.

ca1096301e6801.s:
Consider the following statements about UNHCR's Global Trends figures for 2025:
1. Global forced displacement increased from 117.8 million to 123.2 million.
2. At the end of 2025 there were 41.6 million refugees and 68.6 million internally displaced persons.
3. 14.7 million people returned home, including 4.4 million refugees and 10.3 million IDPs.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca1096301e6801.x: 2 and 3 are correct; displacement actually fell from 123.2 million to 117.8 million, the first decline in a decade.

ca8d47c93044af.s: The National Report on Deep-Sea and Distant-Water Fishery Resources of the Indian EEZ was released by:
ca8d47c93044af.x: It was released by the Centre for Marine Living Resources and Ecology (CMLRE), Kochi, under the Ministry of Earth Sciences.

ca9a946bcc4d78.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. By 2050, one in five Indians is projected to be aged 60 or above.
2. About 70% of this elderly population is projected to live in urban areas.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca9a946bcc4d78.x: Statement 1 is correct; about 70% of the elderly are projected to live in rural, not urban, areas.

ca2cd9b6c9cb8d.s:
Consider the following statements about Tamil Nadu in the NOTTO report:
1. It ranked second in deceased donors, with 266 donors.
2. It ranked second after Delhi in total transplants, with 2,796 transplants.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca2cd9b6c9cb8d.x: Tamil Nadu ranked first, not second, in deceased donors (266); it was second after Delhi in total transplants.

caa7aa85141b8d.s: Which of the following describes the strategy used in India's malaria-control efforts?
o: Passive surveillance, mass drug administration, insecticide-treated nets and fogging
Active surveillance, mass vaccination, insecticide-treated nets and fogging
Active surveillance, Test-Treat-Track, insecticide-treated nets and indoor residual spraying
Active surveillance, Test-Treat-Track, mass vaccination and indoor residual spraying
caa7aa85141b8d.x: The strategy combines active surveillance, Test-Treat-Track, insecticide-treated nets and indoor residual spraying.

ca828a0758031b.s: Which of the following pairs related to malaria is correctly matched?
ca828a0758031b.x: Malaria is spread by the infected female Anopheles mosquito; it is caused by Plasmodium, with P. falciparum the most severe species and P. vivax another species.

ca26e07bc0ca9c.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The National Framework for Malaria Elimination was launched in 2016.
2. World Malaria Day is observed on 24 April.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca26e07bc0ca9c.x: The framework dates to 2016, but World Malaria Day is on 25 April.

ca94c09292d471.s: In the Rural Health Infrastructure Index (28 States), which of the following State–rank pairs is correctly matched?
ca94c09292d471.x: Meghalaya ranked 3rd; Arunachal Pradesh was 1st, Kerala 2nd and Mizoram 4th.

cad728ab34f9d6.s: Which statistical method was used to build the Rural Health Infrastructure Index from Health Dynamics of India 2022–23 data?
cad728ab34f9d6.x: The index used Principal Component Analysis on Health Dynamics of India–Infrastructure and Human Resources 2022–23.

ca7acdd3bb5730.s: Which of the following was NOT among the relatively low-ranked richer States in the Rural Health Infrastructure Index?
ca7acdd3bb5730.x: The low-ranked richer States were Gujarat, Maharashtra, Punjab, Karnataka and Haryana; Tamil Nadu was not among them.

ca7425c20e767f.s: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) was launched in which year and under which ministry?
o: 2014, Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
2015, Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
ca7425c20e767f.x: PMKVY was launched in 2015 under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.

ca0d5d9359a69a.s: India's target of 500 GW of non-fossil capacity by 2030 is part of its Nationally Determined Contribution under the:
ca0d5d9359a69a.x: The 500 GW target is part of India's NDC under the Paris Agreement, 2015.

caebd782d8715b.s: Which of the following pairs related to India's nuclear milestones is correctly matched?
caebd782d8715b.x: National Technology Day is observed on 11 May. Pokhran-I was on 18 May 1974, and Pokhran-II (Operation Shakti) comprised five tests in May 1998.

ca064d371deb4b.s: According to the BIMCO–ICS Seafarer Workforce Report 2026, India is the world's ____ supplier of seafarers.
ca064d371deb4b.x: India is the second-largest supplier (over 3,11,000 seafarers, 12.16% of the global workforce) after the Philippines; it was fifth in 2015.

ca09b21743be5e.s: Which country ranked first in the Athletics Integrity Unit report on doping violations?
ca09b21743be5e.x: India ranked first with 162 athletes and staff involved, ahead of Kenya (148) and Russia (about 60).

caf5724971f3aa.s: According to UNCTAD, in 2025 India became the world's ____ ship recycler, meeting its Maritime India Vision 2030 target five years early.
caf5724971f3aa.x: India became the world's largest ship recycler in 2025, five years ahead of the Maritime India Vision 2030 target.

ca85cd671bf380.s: In 2025, India overtook which country to become the world's second-largest solar market by annual capacity additions?
ca85cd671bf380.x: India overtook the USA in 2025 to become the second-largest solar market by annual capacity additions.

cad990519f2267.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The National Solar Mission was launched in 2010 under the NAPCC.
2. The International Solar Alliance was established in 2015 with its headquarters at Paris.
3. Pralhad Joshi was the MNRE Minister.
Which of the above statements are correct?
cad990519f2267.x: 1 and 3 are correct; the ISA (2015) is headquartered at Gurugram, not Paris.

ca76aa7a922a14.s: Which airport became the world's busiest for international passengers in the first half of 2026, overtaking London Heathrow?
ca76aa7a922a14.x: Incheon (South Korea) led with 38.4 million international passengers, ahead of Heathrow (37.79 million) and Singapore Changi.

ca565cd622bf81.s: Under the Logistics Port Performance Index 2024–25, which port topped the Container Cargo segment?
ca565cd622bf81.x: Mundra topped Container Cargo; Paradip led Dry Bulk and Sikka led Liquid Bulk.

cab75390b522a2.s: In the 67th TOP500 list released at ISC 2026, which of the following system–rank pairs is correctly matched?
cab75390b522a2.x: Frontier ranked 3rd; Lineshine was 1st, El Capitan 2nd and Aurora 4th.

ca0ec873a76aff.s: Which of the following pairs related to India's nuclear diplomacy is correctly matched?
o: NPT and CTBT – India is a member
MTCR, Wassenaar Arrangement and Australia Group – India has not signed them
ca0ec873a76aff.x: India opposes the TPNW. It has not signed the NPT and CTBT, is a member of MTCR, Wassenaar and the Australia Group, and 2008 brought the India–US civil nuclear deal and NSG waiver.

caadc82e70e86e.s: The 6th Economic Census was conducted by:
o: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
Office of the Registrar General of India
caadc82e70e86e.x: The 6th Economic Census was conducted by MoSPI.

cad78ecfbed3a8.s:
Consider the following statements about India in the Environmental Performance Index 2026:
1. Its weakest area was air quality, ranked 141st.
2. Its biodiversity rank was 174th.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cad78ecfbed3a8.x: India's air-quality rank was 174th, not 141st; biodiversity was also 174th.
